integrity: The full normal form, reconstruction, automorphism isomorphism, and modularity/distributivity thresholds follow from an explicit arbitrary-order proof. Enumeration of 18,247 small labeled trees corroborates but does not certify general statements. No independent external review or priority certification was performed.
limitations: Finite simple trees with at least three vertices and reflexive, symmetric closed-neighborhood incidence; ordinary graph incidence, open-neighborhood contexts, arbitrary graphs and rough approximation maps are not covered. The two-vertex tree is excluded. Priority may be anticipated by differently phrased neighborhood-context results.
title: Rank-four reconstruction and sharp modularity for tree-neighborhood concept lattices
